title: [BUG] dbt-fusion debug fails to connect to snowflake where dbt-core connects
body:
**Describe the bug**
dbtFusion is not able to connect to snowflake using the exact same profile as dbtCore

**What version of dbt Fusion is this bug in? (find out by running `dbt --version`)**
dbt-fusion 2.0.0-preview.168

**Is this a discrepancy between the dbt Fusion Engine and dbt Core? Check one.**
- [x] YES
- [ ] NO

**To Reproduce**
$ dbtf debug --connection
dbt-fusion 2.0.0-preview.168
   Loading ~/.dbt/profiles.yml
 Debugging profile: dev
 Debugging dbt version: 2.0.0-preview.168
 Debugging platform: windows x86_64 (windows)
 Debugging adapter type: snowflake (remote)
   Skipped steps before connection testing
 Debugging connection:
  "account": "BI-EMEA",
  "user": "X2DFHPMS2DEV@BOEHRINGER-INGELHEIM.COM",
  "database": "DEV_DFHPMS2EU_DB",
  "warehouse": "DEV_DFHPMS2EU_VDW_ETL",
  "schema": "LANDING_DFHPMS2EU_SCHEMA",
  "role": "BI-AS-ATLASSIAN-P-DFHPMS2EU-TEAM"
New version available 2.0.0-preview.171 (run `dbt system update`)

=============================================== Errors and Warnings ================================================
error: dbt1011: dbt was unable to connect to the specified database.
The following error was returned:

Post "https://BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com:443/session/v1/login-request?databaseName=DEV_DFHPMS2EU_DB&requestId=24290c33-70df-4bea-6a6f-f70230fe2961&request_guid=03357816-fbac-40c7-6ef3-e4686741cc07&roleName=BI-AS-ATLASSIAN-P-DFHPMS2EU-TEAM&schemaName=LANDING_DFHPMS2EU_SCHEMA&warehouse=DEV_DFHPMS2EU_VDW_ETL": dial tcp: lookup BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com on [fdfa:1177:bb83:425b:4000:0:8d:1]:53: no such host

Check your database credentials and try again. For more information, visit:
https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/core/connect-data-platform/connection-profiles

Connection has been checked with different commands, this is what we've found so far:
(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> Get-ChildItem Env: | findstr -i proxy
(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> netsh winhttp show proxy

Configuración actual del proxy WinHTTP:

    Acceso directo (sin servidor proxy).

(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> nslookup BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com
Servidor:  UnKnown
Address:  fdfa:1177:bb83:425b:4000:0:8d:1

*** UnKnown no encuentra BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com: Non-existent domain
(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> Get-ChildItem Env: | findstr -i proxy                                                                               nslookup BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com 8.8.8.8sers\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> 
Servidor:  dns.google
Address:  8.8.8.8

Respuesta no autoritativa:
Nombre:  aef6b1ab4be690ffee73053816ea69e6.e1.eu-west-1.aws.app.snowflake.com
Addresses:  52.215.130.155
          54.228.217.132
          54.194.92.182
Aliases:  BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com
          partition-01.lbid-3.ie.traffic.snowflakecomputing.com
          lbid-3.ie.lb.snowflakecomputing.com

(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> 
(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> nslookup BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com 8.8.8.8
Servidor:  dns.google
Address:  8.8.8.8

Respuesta no autoritativa:
Nombre:  aef6b1ab4be690ffee73053816ea69e6.e1.eu-west-1.aws.app.snowflake.com
Addresses:  52.215.130.155
          54.194.92.182
          54.228.217.132
Aliases:  BI-EMEA.snowflakecomputing.com
          partition-01.lbid-3.ie.traffic.snowflakecomputing.com
          lbid-3.ie.lb.snowflakecomputing.com

(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> netsh winhttp show proxy

Configuración actual del proxy WinHTTP:

    Acceso directo (sin servidor proxy).

(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' | Select-Object ProxyServer, ProxyEnable

ProxyServer ProxyEnable
----------- -----------
                      0


(base) PS C:\Users\sanzasan\Documents\dbt_project\dbt-env\dfhpms2eu-snowflake-dbt> python -c "import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.getproxies())"
{}
**Expected behavior**
Connect smoothly as dbt core does

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Operating System and CPU Type (please complete the following information):**
* Windows?
* X86?

comments.author: jorgesanza
comments.body: the issue is related to the use of corporate VPN routing the traffic using IPv6 which was preventing to reach out snowflakecomputing.com, to overcome it we just edited the hosts files to incluide 8.8.8.8 and now we're able to connect.
